- Primary use case: secure inference for PHI-enriched clinical workflows (HIPAA scope).
- Key security/compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II report, HIPAA-ready controls (BAA), GDPR data residency, and a short vendor security questionnaire.
- IAM specifics requested: SSO/SAML support, SCIM provisioning (user/provisioning flow), RBAC roles and admin controls, audit logging for admin actions.

Next steps I promised:
1) Share our SOC 2 status and an IAM controls matrix that maps to ZenWell's questionnaire items.
2) Initiate the vendor security questionnaire — can we get the security contact to send over the questionnaire PDF/Doc?

Could you loop in your security team or forward the questionnaire? We're prepared to provide SAML metadata, SCIM endpoint details, and a short admin user guide.

Thanks — will follow up with the attachments and answers.

Hi Sarah / ZenWell security team —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. I've filled the high-priority sections and attached the following artifacts for your review: 
- redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report)
- iam-controls-matrix.xlsx (mapping of IAM controls to your questionnaire items)
- scim-configuration-guide.pdf (endpoints, example payloads, auth)

Answers to your quick questions:
- SSO: We support SAML 2.0 with both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. We can provide SAML metadata for Redwood (SP) or consume your IdP metadata. Common IdPs tested: Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin.
- SCIM: Full SCIM 2.0 provisioning (Users and Groups). Provisioning is over HTTPS with token-based auth (short-lived bearer token that can be rotated). Example endpoints included in the attached SCIM guide. Supports create, update, deactivate (we soft-delete) and group membership sync.
- RBAC & admin controls: We expose three primary roles by default — Admin, Developer, Auditor — with configurable custom roles for enterprise plans. Admin role changes and provisioning events are logged and retained per the retention policy (see controls matrix).
- Audit logs: Admin actions (role changes, user provisioning, API key rotations) are available via our audit log stream and in-console export. We can provide a sample log extract upon request.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads in our Dedicated and Private deployments. We can execute a BAA; I can loop in Legal after you confirm intent to proceed.

If you'd like, we can also provide SAML metadata and a short test guide to spin up a test connection before production.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute security deep-dive on Wed 17 Mar or Thu 18 Mar (PST) to walk through SAML/SCIM and review any questionnaire clarifications. Please share availability.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
